admitted_route.name: toRvik-data GitHub CSV mirror of the BartTorvik T-Rank archive, pinned by commit

known_limitations: The pinned mirror repository was last pushed 2023-06-20; its archive coverage ends during the 2022-23 season. Post-2023 archive dates return 404 on this route.

Schema drift across seasons: the 2023-03-12 file carries a leading unnamed index column that the 2022-01-13 file does not. Parsers must tolerate it; a silent column shift is a refusal, not a repair opportunity.

The mirror repository carries no license file. T-Rank data remains Bart Torvik's; see the license section of ADMISSION_RECORD.md. This repo records hashes and manifests only and redistributes no sample data.
